summary: GRI 302: Energy 2016 contains disclosures for reporting an organization's energy-related impacts and how it manages them. It covers energy consumption within and outside the organization, energy intensity, reductions in energy consumption, and reductions in the energy requirements of products and services.

questions.text: Describe the actual and potential, negative and positive impacts of the organization on the economy, environment and people, including impacts on their human rights, in relation to energy.
questions.hint: Describe the actual and potential, negative and positive impacts on the economy, environment, and people, including impacts on human rights (GRI 3-3-a).

questions.text: State whether the organization is involved with the negative impacts related to energy through its own activities or as a result of its business relationships, and describe how.
questions.hint: Say whether the organization causes or contributes to the negative impacts through its activities, or whether they are linked to its operations, products or services through business relationships, and describe how (GRI 3-3-b).

questions.text: Describe the organization's policies or commitments regarding energy.
questions.hint: Describe policies or commitments regarding the material topic (GRI 3-3-c).

questions.text: Describe the actions taken to manage energy and the related impacts.
questions.hint: Include: i. how negative impacts are prevented or mitigated; ii. how actual negative impacts are addressed, including actions to provide for or cooperate in remediation; iii. how actual and potential positive impacts are managed (GRI 3-3-d).

questions.text: How does the organization track the effectiveness of its actions on energy?
questions.hint: Report: i. information about the effectiveness of the actions; ii. the goals, targets and indicators used to evaluate progress; iii. lessons learned and how they have been integrated into policies and operational procedures (GRI 3-3-e).

questions.text: Describe how engagement with stakeholders has informed the actions taken on energy and whether those actions have been effective.
questions.hint: Describe how stakeholder engagement has informed the actions taken (3-3-d) and how it has informed whether the actions have been effective (3-3-e) (GRI 3-3-f).

questions.text: What is the total fuel consumption within the organization from non-renewable sources, and which fuel types are used?
questions.hint: In joules or multiples, including fuel types used.

questions.text: What is the total fuel consumption within the organization from renewable sources, and which fuel types are used?
questions.hint: In joules or multiples, including fuel types used.

questions.text: What is the total electricity, heating, cooling and steam consumption?
questions.hint: In joules, watt-hours or multiples: i. electricity; ii. heating; iii. cooling; iv. steam consumption.

questions.text: What is the total electricity, heating, cooling and steam sold?
questions.hint: In joules, watt-hours or multiples: i. electricity sold; ii. heating sold; iii. cooling sold; iv. steam sold.

questions.text: What is the total energy consumption within the organization?
questions.hint: In joules or multiples.

questions.text: Which standards, methodologies, assumptions and/or calculation tools were used?
questions.hint: Standards, methodologies, assumptions, and/or calculation tools used.

questions.text: What is the source of the conversion factors used?
questions.hint: Source of the conversion factors used.

questions.hint: In joules or multiples.

questions.text: Which standards, methodologies, assumptions and/or calculation tools were used?
questions.hint: Standards, methodologies, assumptions, and/or calculation tools used.

questions.text: What is the source of the conversion factors used?
questions.hint: Source of the conversion factors used.

questions.hint: Energy intensity ratio for the organization.

questions.hint: Organization-specific metric (the denominator) chosen.

questions.text: Which types of energy are included in the intensity ratio?

questions.text: Does the ratio use energy consumption within the organization, outside of it, or both?
questions.hint: Whether the ratio uses energy consumption within the organization, outside of it, or both.

questions.hint: In joules or multiples.
